daily_thesis: The July 29 batch shifts the useful comparison from model scale to exposed evidence. CoTinyVLA, IDR, SAM3D-VLA, DC-WAM, and pi R2 all ask what intermediate state the robot policy can reveal before the next action is trusted: phase reasoning, causal modality effect, 3D object prior, dynamic token, or fresh proprioceptive channel. HiFi-UMI and SONG make a parallel move at the data and simulator layer by tying scale to pose fidelity, synchronization, replay, photorealistic episodes, and social-safety labels. FIRMGrasp and track-leakage-free photogrammetry show the validation version of the same lesson: confidence is only useful when the adverse tail and blind spot are named. APRL should turn today's batch into evidence-bearing rollout ledgers before comparing larger VLA or world-model checkpoints.

The common decision is to expose a control-relevant state before treating the action as valid.
clusters.confidence_note: Five robot-control papers independently target hidden evidence inside the action path.
clusters.lab_action: Log one action rollout with Plan/Think text, visual-counterfactual action delta, target-object 3D-prior flag, dynamic-token salience, fresh proprioception age, and final action error; test which field predicts failure first.

paper_autopsies.title: CoTinyVLA: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for a Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language-Action Model
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Robotics papers often treat VLA robustness as a backbone scale problem, leaving the smaller model to imitate actions without a visible task-phase rationale.
paper_autopsies.friction: Embedded robots need low memory use, but compact action models usually lose robustness on initial-state, object, and long-horizon perturbations.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A small VLA can inherit useful structure if the teacher exposes an episode plan and chunk-level reasoning, rather than only final actions.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: CoTinyVLA distills hierarchical reasoning into a 0.9B VLA with dual-view temporal history and paraphrase-expanded language supervision.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: The model assembles third-person frames, wrist frames, proprioception, and instruction tokens, then distills Plan and Think spans from a larger teacher into action prediction.

decisive_evidence.claim: The architecture is organized as a four-stage pipeline with dual camera histories, proprioception, language, hierarchical CoT, and action prediction.
The paper defines hierarchical chain-of-thought supervision with episode-level Plan and chunk-level Think spans.
LIBERO-Plus Spatial and Object tables report higher total success than the strongest 7B baseline.
Closed-loop inference peaks at 2.25 GiB allocated GPU memory, and removing or contradicting the episode Plan costs 40 to 45 success points.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If Plan/Think spans improve only prompt paraphrase robustness but not physical perturbations, the method is mostly language regularization.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Teacher reasoning can be plausible but wrong. The release needs failure cases where the distilled Plan is inspected against actual robot state transitions.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Log a robot action together with the compact model's phase explanation, gripper-state belief, and next subaction, then score which field fails first.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The idea transfers to manipulation tasks with stable subtask phases. It is weaker for highly reactive contact tasks where language-level phase is not the limiting variable.

paper_autopsies.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Robot-free demonstrations are usually treated as scalable pretraining data, while a smaller real-robot anchor is still assumed necessary for deployment.
paper_autopsies.friction: UMI data can scale, but inaccurate hand pose, poor synchronization, and narrow field of view can make the learned policy brittle on the robot.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A robot-free corpus can replace a real-robot anchor only when the capture system preserves the control-relevant state at deployment fidelity.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: HiFi-UMI co-designs head-mounted stereo-inertial SLAM, native relative pose, microsecond GPIO synchronization, and wide hand cameras for high-fidelity robot-free data.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: The device and processing pipeline reconstruct high-quality hand trajectories and validate demonstrations through simulation replay before using them for policy post-training.

decisive_evidence.claim: The paper presents a robot-free pipeline from data collection through real-robot policy deployment.
The capture device combines a head-mounted stereo camera pair, per-hand marker cubes, and synchronized wide-angle hand cameras.
Data-quality criteria are a first-class part of the system rather than an afterthought.
The paper reports 3 mm workspace-local end-effector accuracy and direct deployment without robot post-training across three policy backbones.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If zero-robot post-training fails outside the captured scene family, the system may still be an in-domain teleoperation substitute rather than a general data moat.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Fidelity can be concentrated in pose while contact force, compliance, or object dynamics remain missing. Replay validation should expose which failure modes the corpus cannot see.
